description: Derived controlled-language dictionary for the LAAS legal and contracts profile. The markdown tables in legal.md section 3 are authoritative; this file is derived from them. Each term carries exactly one approved meaning and one part of speech (STE-C-04). No term appears in both the nouns list and the verbs list: execute is the verb and execution version is the noun; waive is the verb and waiver is the noun; mark up is the verb and redline is the noun.

nouns.meaning: A document that two or more named parties have executed and that binds them.
An executed document that changes a term of an existing agreement.
A transfer of a party's rights under an agreement to a named third party.
The named signatory, the delegation instrument, and the clause that permits a party to bind an entity.
A notice that states a named failure to perform, the clause breached, and the cure period.
A numbered provision of an instrument, identified by its number and the instrument.
An event that must occur before a stated obligation becomes due.
A duty not to disclose defined information to a named class of recipient for a stated period.
A recorded search for a relationship that would prevent a party from acting in a matter.
The value each party gives that makes an agreement enforceable.
The external legal entity on the other side of an instrument or a negotiation.
A promise to do or not to do a stated act during the term.
The stated period in which a breaching party may remedy a named breach before a remedy becomes available.
A word or phrase that an instrument defines in a numbered clause and capitalises on every use.
The document that grants a named person authority to bind an entity, such as a power of attorney or a board resolution.
A formal demand in litigation that a party produce named documents or answer named questions.
One numbered item on a court's public record of a matter.
A document in negotiation that no party has executed.
The date stated in an instrument on which its obligations begin.
The final text of a document, agreed by all parties and awaiting signature.
The absolute time by which a document must reach a named court or registry.
The clause that excuses performance on the occurrence of a named event outside a party's control.
The court or the arbitral body named in an instrument to hear a dispute.
The legal system that an instrument names to interpret it.
An obligation of one party to cover a named loss of another party.
An instruction that suspends deletion of named records because litigation is reasonably anticipated.
The clause that caps or excludes a party's liability, stated with a cap amount and a cap basis.
The period after which a claim can no longer be brought.
The framework agreement whose terms govern individual statements of work.
One identified piece of legal work, identified by a matter number.
An agreement whose primary obligation is a confidentiality obligation.
The clause that states how a notice must be delivered, to whom, and when it takes effect.
A named legal entity that an instrument binds.
The recorded privilege state of a named document.
The record listing documents withheld from production and the ground for withholding each.
A marked-up draft that shows every proposed change against a named prior version.
A further period for which an agreement continues after the initial term.
A statement of fact about the present or the past, made by a named party on a stated date.
An executed agreement that resolves a dispute and states what each party gives up.
A separate executed document that varies an agreement between fewer than all parties to it.
The named natural person who signs on behalf of a party.
A document that states the scope, the deliverables, and the fees under a master services agreement.
Termination permitted by a named breach that the breaching party did not cure.
Termination permitted without a breach, on stated notice.
A document that records agreed commercial points and states which of them bind.
A recorded decision by a party not to enforce a named right, effective on notice.
A promise that a stated fact is and remains true, with a stated remedy if it is not.

verbs.meaning: Agree to a named proposed change or a named offer, with the accepting party recorded.
Record receipt of a document without agreeing to its terms.
Change a term of an existing agreement by an executed amendment.
Transfer a party's rights under an agreement to a named third party.
State, as a named person, that a stated fact is true, with the basis recorded.
Identify an authority in the form required by section 2.1 deviation 2.
Add the second party's signature to a document the first party has already signed.
Remedy a named breach within the cure period.
Make a named document or fact available to a named recipient.
Route a decision to a named approver or a named queue.
Complete a document as binding by the signature of an authorised signatory.
Deliver a document to a named court or registry so that it enters the record.
Cover a named loss of another party under an indemnity.
Exchange proposed changes to a draft with a named counterparty.
Deliver a notice in the form and to the address the notice provision requires.
Replace a party to an agreement with a named third party, with all parties consenting.
Deliver named documents in response to a discovery request.
Record every proposed change to a draft against a named prior version, producing a redline.
Unwind an agreement so that the parties return to their pre-agreement position.
Deliver a document to a named party in the manner the forum requires.
Conclude a dispute by an executed settlement agreement.
Deliver a record to a named downstream system or a named internal reviewer.
End an agreement under a named termination clause, with the effective date stated.
Compare a claim against an independent source and record the result.
Give up a named right, effective on notice, with the waiving party recorded.
Refuse a consent or a document, with the named ground recorded.

forbidden.reason: Collapses draft, execution version, and agreement, which differ in reversibility.
A legal conclusion the agent did not observe.
forbidden.replacement: the document state, the authority basis, and the execution date

forbidden.reason: Signing without authority does not bind. The two are different acts.
forbidden.replacement: execute with the authority basis, or acknowledge

forbidden.reason: Collides with the consequence enum value at conformance/laas/data.json:9 and with the contractual term of art.
forbidden.replacement: the enum value, or Material Adverse Change with its defined threshold

forbidden.reason: An unmeasured standard read differently in each forum.
forbidden.replacement: the named acts required, or the clause that defines the standard
an absolute timestamp and the event it runs from (STE-LEGAL-05)

forbidden.reason: Asserts that a clause needs no review.
forbidden.replacement: the clause citation and the text that differs from the named template
the citation form at section 2.1 deviation 2

forbidden.reason: Reads as exhaustive to one party and illustrative to the other.
forbidden.replacement: including without limitation, or the complete list

forbidden.reason: Hides whether the item is a condition precedent, a carve-out, or a cross-reference.
forbidden.replacement: condition precedent, or the named carve-out and its clause

forbidden.reason: Means the duration of an agreement or a provision of it.
forbidden.replacement: renewal term, initial term, or clause

forbidden.reason: An unattributed and unscoped review claim.
forbidden.replacement: the named reviewer, the scope reviewed, and the date
the consequence lattice value and the liability position (STE-LEGAL-08)

forbidden.reason: A waiver is an effective act that gives up a right permanently.
forbidden.replacement: waive only for the act; did not enforce on this occasion for a one-off

forbidden.reason: Means conclude a dispute by an executed settlement agreement.
forbidden.replacement: settle only for a dispute; complete for finishing work
the actor_id or the named component
